```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.6
library(ggplot2)

theta <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 500)
a0 <- 2; b0 <- 2          # prior Beta(2, 2)
y  <- 7; n  <- 10         # 7 successes in 10 trials

d <- rbind(
  data.frame(theta, density = dbeta(theta, a0, b0),               what = "prior"),
  data.frame(theta, density = dbeta(theta, y + 1, n - y + 1),     what = "likelihood"),
  data.frame(theta, density = dbeta(theta, a0 + y, b0 + n - y),   what = "posterior")
)
d$what <- factor(d$what, levels = c("prior", "likelihood", "posterior"))

ggplot(d, aes(theta, density, colour = what)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey60", "#e07b39", "#1b6ca8"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = expression(theta), y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
